One system for improving memory and comprehension, as described by both Quintilian (in Institutes of Oratory, Book XI, "De copia" and Book XII, "De ratio studii") and Francis Bacon, is to make notes on whatever you are reading, categorized by theme. These commonplaces can be carried in boxes that accompany you. When assembling a new book, go through the topics and cross out commonplace notes as you use them.

In the world of athletics, Yarisley Silva, a Cuban athlete, has achieved significant success in the pole vault event. In 2010, her throw of 55.53 m at the nationals brought her her first podium finish at the event, taking third place behind Kara Patterson and Rachel Yurkovich. These finishing positions were repeated at the 2011 USA Outdoor Track and Field Championships.

Juan Rulfo's novel, Pedro Páramo, is considered to be one of the greatest texts written in any language. The story begins with the first-person account of Juan Preciado, who promises his dying mother that he will travel to the town of Comala to find his father, Pedro Páramo."
